title: Fastify: preValidationCallback fails when validation hook modifies request before handler

error_signal.message: fastify TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'method') in handleRequest preValidationCallback when request is modified by preValidation hook

ground_truth.root_cause_description: preValidationCallback in handle-request.js does not guard against mutations to the request object made by preValidation hooks before the handler runs.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add null guard in preValidationCallback before accessing request properties
